RUNTIME_CONTEXT
project: smart-building
repo: buildingos
service: hvac-controller
task: Working on the hvac-controller service in the smart-building project

CANDIDATE_MEMORIES
m1 [service_memory] [STALE]: The previous on-call rotation used a static weekly schedule that didn't account for timezone differences.
m2 [service_memory]: The hvac-controller requires all downstream service calls to include a client certificate for mutual TLS authentication.
m3 [repo_memory]: The buildingos CI pipeline enforces that no PR is merged if it increases the p95 latency of any hvac-controller endpoint by more than 10%.
m4 [service_memory] [STALE]: Before the microservice migration, all logic was in a Rails monolith decommissioned in 2022.

CURRENT_UNITS
u1: I prefer the fleet dashboard to show a heatmap overlay of current vehicle density rather than individual vehicle markers.
u2: Configuration for the hvac-controller lives under `hvac-controller/config/` in the buildingos repo, with separate files for dev, staging, and production.
{"read": [], "store": [{"target": "user_profile", "unit_id": "u1"}, {"target": "repo_memory", "unit_id": "u2"}], "skip": []}

CANDIDATE_MEMORIES
m1 [service_memory] [STALE]: Before the observability overhaul, debugging a production issue required SSH access to individual servers.
